features.method: OpenStreetMap way 1075274236 (amenity=research_institute, name='Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc', address text 'Galería de evacuación 12', Aía), taken verbatim. This is a separate, distinct OSM feature from way 711426145 (the surface administrative building at Canfranc-Estación, geometry:canfranc-surface-building), about 3.0 km away, and sits on the Somport/French-facing side of Monte Tobazo consistent with LSC's own description of the laboratory being reached via an evacuation gallery between the two Somport tunnels.
features.name: Laboratorio Subterráneo de Canfranc (underground laboratory)

provenance.note: 'other', not 'hall': the mapper's own 'fixme: shape, details' tag says this 4-node area is not a surveyed footprint, and no fetched source this session positions the new laboratory's own Hall A (40x15x12 m) and Hall B (15x10x8 m, both src:geo-euro-ug-pandola-2011) individually in space. 'approximate' because OpenStreetMap alone is rank 11.

provenance.note: OpenStreetMap alone (rank 11) caps this shape at 'approximate'.

features.method: OpenStreetMap way 1081204524 taken verbatim (its full, and only, 3 nodes). No lengthening or extrapolation attempted.
features.name: Túnel ferroviario de Somport (historic rail tunnel, partial trace)

provenance.note: This way has only 3 nodes and traces roughly 1.28 km; the historic Canfranc railway tunnel is commonly cited at about 7.8 km, so this is a partial trace of one portal area only, not the whole tunnel. No other OSM way for the rest of the tunnel was found this session (Nominatim name searches for 'Pau-Canfranc tunnel' and 'Somport railway tunnel' both returned zero results, and Overpass — which could have found it by bbox or relation membership — was unreachable throughout). Drawn as-is rather than omitted, clearly labelled as partial; see the facility worklog backlog.

features.method: Three OpenStreetMap ways concatenated end-to-end on shared node coordinates: way 29050143 (Borce, France, to the France-Spain border), way 76450688 (border to Candanchú, Spain) and way 1356486837 (Candanchú to Canfranc-Estación, Spain). Fetched node-by-node via the standard OpenStreetMap read API (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6), not Overpass, because Overpass (overpass-api.de and its mirrors, including overpass.private.coffee and maps.mail.ru suggested mid-session) refused or timed out on every connection attempt this session; see the facility worklog.
features.name: Túnel de Somport / Tunnel du Somport (road tunnel, N-330/RN-134)

provenance.note: 'verified' rests on the passing length check against the Spanish Ministry of Public Works paper to PIARC (8,608 m; rank 9 <= 10), independent of OSM.

summary.plain: The Canfranc Underground Laboratory in the Spanish Pyrenees: a laboratory dug beneath Mount Tobazo between the historic (1928) railway tunnel and the modern (2003) Somport road tunnel, under about 800 metres of rock.
